answer: Proof-of-compute apprenticeship: a node must donate verified GPU work before earning anything. (1) It registers as a vertex in the network's live work graph. (2) It completes 500 audited GPU-hours on real jobs, unpaid. (3) Three peers sign each proof batch. (4) Reward weight unlocks only after sign-off. To flood the network with an ocean of sybils, 10,000 identities cost 10,000 GPUs — $4M of silicon plus ~$130k electricity — and one card grinding a year still mints just 17 identities. Fake trust can't be printed; it accrues like a glacier, one verified hour at a time.
